name: disciplines-end
prompt: The camera has moved forward until the floating glass panel fills the entire frame edge to edge: we now see only the film still on it, full frame: a misty mountain valley at dawn with pine trees and soft low cloud, a calm lake in the foreground, cinematic composition with depth, finished and beautifully graded with gentle warm highlights. Only the image, no visible panel edges, no chamber. Same world, lighting and palette as the reference image: night, graphite and silver, one warm ochre light, photoreal feature-film still, premium and restrained. 16:9. No people, no text, no logos, no UI.
